question: The average monthly income of P and Q is Rs. 5,050. The average monthly income of Q and R is Rs. 6,250 and the average monthly income of P and R is Rs. 5,200. The monthly income of P (in Rs.) is:
solution:
**Given:**

The average monthly income of P and Q is Rs. 5,050

The average monthly income of Q and R is Rs. 6,250

The average monthly income of P and R is Rs. 5,200

**Formula used:**

Average = (Sum of incomes) / (Number of people)

**Calculation:**

P + Q = 5050 × 2 = 10100 ............(1) 

Q + R = 6250 × 2 = 12500 ............(2)

P + R = 5200 × 2 = 10400 ............(3)

Adding the three equations:

(P + Q) + (Q + R) + (P + R) = 10100 + 12500 + 10400

⇒ 2P + 2Q + 2R = 33000

⇒ P + Q + R = 16500 ............(4)

Subtracting Q + R = 12500 from Equation (4)

P = 16500 - 12500

⇒ P = 4000

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**
